headline: Khaitan & Co advises Olyv on extended Series C fundraise
sum: Smartcoin Financials Private Limited, dba Olyv, has raised ₹58 crore from an extended Series C fundraise, securing investments from Nippon India Digital Innovation and Fundamentum Partnership – Fund II. Khaitan & Co advised Olyv on this…
detail: Smartcoin Financials Private Limited, dba Olyv, has raised ₹58 crore from an extended Series C fundraise, securing investments from Nippon India Digital Innovation and Fundamentum Partnership – Fund II. Khaitan & Co advised Olyv on this fundraise. The Firm assisted in the negotiation and finalisation of the transaction documents, and conducting a vendor legal due diligence on Olyv and its subsidiaries. The transaction team consisted of Sanchit Agarwal (Partner), Jubin Jay (Principal Associate), Deepansh Goyal (Senior Associate), Aastha Agarwallaa (Senior Associate) and Nidhi Gupta (Senior Associate).
